BranchIntroduction: Go over to domains with <u>Blessing Trotter</u> or <u>Curio Trotter</u> Beacon.
StartingEffectDescToast: At the start of the First and Second Plane, additionally generates 1 Blessing Trotter Beacon and 1 Curio Trotter Beacon.
EffectDescParam1: At the start of the First and Second Plane, additionally generates 1 <u>Blessing Trotter</u> beacon and 1 <u>Curio Trotter</u> beacon.
EffectDescParam2: Obtains <unbreak>1[i]</unbreak> Cosmic Fragment(s) for each Trotter defeated.
EffectDescParam3: For every 1 time(s) a passive effect is triggered, gain the <u>Path Boost</u> effect of the selected Path.

StartingEffectDescToast: At the start of the First and Second Plane, apply Knowledge to <unbreak>1[i]</unbreak> random domains.
EffectDescParam1: At the start of the First and Second Plane, apply <u>Knowledge</u> to <unbreak>1[i]</unbreak> random domain(s).
EffectDescParam2: When a domain receives <u>Knowledge</u>, a random beacon will be generated for it.
EffectDescParam3: Whenever allies enter a domain with the <u>Knowledge</u> effect, gain the <u>Path Boost</u> effect for the selected Path.

BranchIntroduction: Go over to domains with different beacons.
StartingEffectDescToast: At the start of the First and Second Plane, additionally generate <unbreak>1[i]</unbreak> random beacon(s).
EffectDescParam1: At the start of the First and Second Plane, additionally generate <unbreak>1[i]</unbreak> random beacon(s).
EffectDescParam2: When entering a domain with a beacon, obtain <unbreak>1[i]</unbreak> Blessing(s). Only takes effect once for each type of beacon across each Plane.
EffectDescParam3: Whenever allies enter a domain with a beacon, gain the <u>Path Boost</u> effect for the selected Path.

BranchIntroduction: Go over to <u>Occurrence</u>, <u>Occurrence: Abnormal</u>, or <u>Reward</u> domains.
StartingEffectDescToast: At the start of the First and Second Plane, cause <unbreak>1[i]</unbreak> random domain(s) to become Reward Domain(s).
EffectDescParam1: At the start of the First and Second Plane, cause <unbreak>1[i]</unbreak> random domains to become <u>Reward</u> domains.
EffectDescParam2: When entering an <u>Occurrence</u>, <u>Occurrence: Abnormal</u>, or <u>Reward</u> domain, immediately obtain <unbreak>1[i]</unbreak> Blessing(s).
EffectDescParam3: For every 1 Occurrence interaction(s) completed, gain the <u>Path Boost</u> effect of the selected Path.

StartingEffectDescToast: At the start of the First and Second Plane, cause <unbreak>1[i]</unbreak> random domain(s) to become Elite Domain(s).
EffectDescParam1: At the start of the First and Second Plane, cause <unbreak>1[i]</unbreak> random domains to become <u>Elite</u> domains.
EffectDescParam2: Achieve victory in the <u>Elite</u> domain to get <unbreak>1[i]</unbreak> additional Curio(s).
EffectDescParam3: For every 1 battle victory/victories obtained, gain the <u>Path Boost</u> effect for the selected Path.

StartingEffectDescToast: Expands the First and Third Planes.
EffectDescParam1: Expands the First and Third Planes.
EffectDescParam2: During the movement stage, can move to any domain of the same type as the one you are currently in.
EffectDescParam3: Whenever allies enter a non-adjacent domain, gain the <u>Path Boost</u> effect for the selected Path.

StartingEffectDescToast: At the start of the First and Second Plane, apply Knowledge to <unbreak>1[i]</unbreak> random domains.
EffectDescParam1: At the start of the First and Second Plane, apply <u>Knowledge</u> to <unbreak>1[i]</unbreak> random domain(s).
EffectDescParam2: The initial countdown is reduced by <unbreak>1[i]</unbreak>. When entering a domain with the <u>Knowledge</u> effect, recover the countdown by <unbreak>2[i]</unbreak> instead. When entering the <u>Boss</u> Domain, receive a Blessing for every <unbreak>3[i]</unbreak> countdown point(s) in possession.
EffectDescParam3: For every point of countdown remaining, gain the <u>Path Boost</u> effect for the selected Path.

BranchIntroduction: Make the plane have more domains with <u>Knowledge</u>.
StartingEffectDescToast: At the start of the First and Second Plane, apply Knowledge to <unbreak>1[i]</unbreak> random domains.
EffectDescParam1: At the start of the First and Second Plane, apply <u>Knowledge</u> to <unbreak>1[i]</unbreak> random domain(s).
EffectDescParam2: Domains with <u>Knowledge</u> will not collapse. When entering <u>Boss</u>, <u>Occurrence: Abnormal</u>, or <u>Transaction</u> Domains, immediately obtain <unbreak>1[i]</unbreak> Cosmic Fragments for each domain currently under the <u>Knowledge</u> effect in the current plane.
EffectDescParam3: For every 1 time(s) a passive effect is triggered, gain the <u>Path Boost</u> effect of the selected Path.

BranchIntroduction: Give domains the <u>Knowledge</u> effect before they collapse.
StartingEffectDescToast: At the start of the First and Second Plane, apply Knowledge to <unbreak>1[i]</unbreak> random domains.
EffectDescParam1: At the start of the First and Second Plane, apply <u>Knowledge</u> to <unbreak>1[i]</unbreak> random domain(s).
EffectDescParam2: When a domain with <u>Knowledge</u> collapses, obtain <unbreak>1[i]</unbreak> Cosmic Fragment(s). If the collapsed domain is <u>Elite</u>, <u>Reward</u>, or <u>Adventure</u>, the Cosmic Fragments obtained are doubled. If the domain contains beacon(s), the Cosmic Fragments obtained are doubled.
EffectDescParam3: For the collapse of every 1 domain(s) with <u>Knowledge</u>, gain the <u>Path Boost</u> effect for the selected Path.

StartingEffectDescToast: At the start of the First and Second Plane, cause <unbreak>1[i]</unbreak> random domains to become Transaction Domains. Gains <unbreak>2[i]</unbreak> Cosmic Fragments.
EffectDescParam1: At the start of the First and Second Plane, cause <unbreak>1[i]</unbreak> random domains to become <u>Transaction</u> domains. Gains <unbreak>2[i]</unbreak> Cosmic Fragments.
EffectDescParam2: When purchasing items from the Blessing, Curio, or Enhance store, <unbreak>1[i]%</unbreak> of the consumed Cosmic Fragment will be returned
EffectDescParam3: For every 1 Cosmic Fragments consumed, gain the <u>Path Boost</u> effect for the selected Path.

StartingEffectDescToast: At the start of the First and Second Plane, additional generates <unbreak>1[i]</unbreak> Curio Trotter Beacon(s).
EffectDescParam1: At the start of the First and Second Plane, additionally generates <unbreak>1[i]</unbreak> <u>Curio Trotter</u> beacon(s).
EffectDescParam2: For every Curio obtained, immediately gain <unbreak>1[i]</unbreak> Cosmic Fragment(s)
EffectDescParam3: For every 1 Curio(s) in possession, gain the <u>Path Boost</u> effect for the selected Path.

BranchIntroduction: Use "General Buff" Dice Face to enter combat.
StartingEffectDescToast: At the start of each Plane, gains <unbreak>1[i]</unbreak> cheat attempt(s), and applies random beacons to all Combat and Elite Domains.
EffectDescParam1: At the start of each Plane, gains <unbreak>1[i]</unbreak> cheat attempt(s), and applies random beacons to all <u>Combat</u> and <u>Elite</u> domains.
EffectDescParam2: Gain <unbreak>1[i]</unbreak> reroll attempt(s) after moving. General Buff dice faces will not expire. All General Buff dice faces, once rolled, will take effect in the next room.
EffectDescParam3: For every General Buff dice face used and having obtained victory in battle in a domain, gain the <u>Path Boost</u> effect for the selected Path.
